localeTag.description: BCP-47 tag for THIS catalogue. Plural rules are taken from here, not from the browser UI locale: the two can disagree, and the rules must match the words actually on screen.

appDescription.message: Transpose and slow down any audio or video in a page — without the chipmunk effect.

halfTone.description: One semitone, spelled as an interval. Kept apart from the plural forms because English plural rules would render 0.5 as '½ tones'.

errorBlockedByCsp.message: this page's security policy blocks the audio engine
errorBlockedByCsp.description: Shown when a page forbids WebAssembly, which cannot be worked around.
